options.name: Abjuration School
options.benefit: Specialize in defensive and warding magic. Choose two opposition schools and later prepare one bonus abjuration spell at each available spell level.

powers.name: Resistance
powers.summary: Choose an energy type when preparing spells and gain resistance 5, increasing to 10 at 11th level and immunity at 20th level.

powers.name: Protective Ward
powers.summary: Create a 10-foot protective field that grants allies a scaling deflection bonus to AC. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Energy Absorption
powers.summary: Absorb energy damage each day up to a total equal to 3 times wizard level after immunity, vulnerability, and resistance are applied.

options.name: Conjuration School
options.benefit: Specialize in summoning, creation, and magical transportation. Choose two opposition schools and later prepare one bonus conjuration spell at each available spell level.

powers.name: Summoner's Charm
powers.summary: Increase the duration of conjuration summoning spells by half wizard level in rounds, minimum 1; at 20th level one summon monster spell can become permanent.

powers.name: Acid Dart
powers.summary: Make a ranged touch attack within 30 feet for 1d6 acid damage plus 1 per two wizard levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Dimensional Steps
powers.summary: Teleport in 5-foot increments as a standard action, with a daily distance pool equal to 30 feet per wizard level.

options.name: Divination School
options.benefit: Specialize in foresight, remote viewing, and information magic. Choose two opposition schools and later prepare one bonus divination spell at each available spell level.

powers.name: Forewarned
powers.summary: Always act in surprise rounds and gain an initiative bonus equal to half wizard level, minimum +1; at 20th level treat initiative rolls as natural 20s.

powers.name: Diviner's Fortune
powers.summary: Touch a creature to grant a one-round insight bonus equal to half wizard level on attacks, saves, skills, and ability checks. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Scrying Adept
powers.summary: Always notice magical observation and treat scrying subjects as one familiarity step closer.

options.name: Enchantment School
options.benefit: Specialize in controlling and influencing minds. Choose two opposition schools and later prepare one bonus enchantment spell at each available spell level.

powers.name: Enchanting Smile
powers.summary: Gain a scaling enhancement bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate; at 20th level reflect enchantments after a successful save.

powers.name: Dazing Touch
powers.summary: Daze a living creature with no more Hit Dice than wizard level for 1 round with a melee touch attack. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Aura of Despair
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to wizard level; enemies take -2 on attacks, damage, saves, skills, and ability checks.

options.name: Evocation School
options.benefit: Specialize in raw magical energy and damaging effects. Choose two opposition schools and later prepare one bonus evocation spell at each available spell level.

powers.name: Intense Spells
powers.summary: Add half wizard level, minimum +1, to hit point damage from evocation spells once per spell; at 20th level roll twice to overcome spell resistance.

powers.name: Force Missile
powers.summary: Automatically strike a foe with a force missile for 1d4 plus Intense Spells damage. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Elemental Wall
powers.summary: Create an acid, cold, electricity, or fire wall functioning as wall of fire for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Illusion School
options.benefit: Specialize in deceptive images, figments, and phantasms. Choose two opposition schools and later prepare one bonus illusion spell at each available spell level.

powers.name: Extended Illusions
powers.summary: Concentration-duration illusions persist for half wizard level in rounds after concentration ends; at 20th level maintain one such illusion permanently.

powers.name: Blinding Ray
powers.summary: Fire a ray within 30 feet that blinds for 1 round, or dazzles creatures with more Hit Dice than wizard level. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Invisibility Field
powers.summary: Become invisible as greater invisibility using a swift action for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Necromancy School
options.benefit: Specialize in life force, death, and undead magic. Choose two opposition schools and later prepare one bonus necromancy spell at each available spell level.

powers.name: Power over Undead
powers.summary: Gain Command Undead or Turn Undead and channel energy 3 + Intelligence modifier times per day only to power that feat.

powers.name: Grave Touch
powers.summary: Make a living creature shaken for half wizard level in rounds; a second touch can frighten a weaker shaken creature. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Life Sight
powers.summary: Gain short-range blindsight that detects and distinguishes living creatures and undead for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Transmutation School
options.benefit: Specialize in altering creatures, objects, and physical properties. Choose two opposition schools and later prepare one bonus transmutation spell at each available spell level.

powers.name: Physical Enhancement
powers.summary: Gain a scaling enhancement bonus to Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution chosen when preparing spells; at 20th level apply it to two scores.

powers.name: Telekinetic Fist
powers.summary: Make a ranged touch attack within 30 feet for 1d4 bludgeoning damage plus 1 per two wizard levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Change Shape
powers.summary: Assume forms as beast shape II or elemental body I for rounds per day equal to wizard level, improving at 12th level.

options.name: Universalist School
options.benefit: Study all schools without opposition schools. Universalists do not receive specialist school spell slots.

powers.name: Hand of the Apprentice
powers.summary: Throw a held melee weapon up to 30 feet using Intelligence instead of Dexterity on the attack roll; it immediately returns. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Metamagic Mastery
powers.summary: Apply a known metamagic feat without increasing spell level or casting time, with daily uses increasing every two wizard levels after 8th.

options.name: Admixture School
options.benefit: Focus evocation study on changing and manipulating elemental energy. Retain evocation specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Versatile Evocation
powers.summary: Change acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage from an evocation spell to another of those energy types. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Elemental Manipulation
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura that converts one magical energy type into another for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Banishment School
options.benefit: Focus abjuration study on disrupting summoned and called creatures. Retain abjuration specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Unstable Bonds
powers.summary: A melee touch makes a summoned or called creature shaken and staggered for half wizard level in rounds. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Aura of Banishment
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura that staggers and can banish summoned or called creatures after failed Will saves, for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Controller School
options.benefit: Focus enchantment study on commanding creatures and maintaining mental control. Retain enchantment specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Force of Will
powers.summary: Communicate telepathically with creatures you charm or dominate; the link becomes two-way at 11th level, and at 20th level resisted enchantments still affect targets for 1 round.

powers.name: Irresistible Demand
powers.summary: Dominate a creature with no more Hit Dice than wizard level while concentrating, for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Counterspell School
options.benefit: Focus abjuration study on interrupting hostile magic. Retain abjuration specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Disruption
powers.summary: Place a disruptive field with a melee touch, forcing concentration checks to cast for half wizard level in rounds. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Counterspell Mastery
powers.summary: Gain Improved Counterspell and counterspell as an immediate action once per day, plus one additional use every four levels beyond 6th.

options.name: Creation School
options.benefit: Focus conjuration study on creating useful objects. Retain conjuration specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Create Gear
powers.summary: Create a simple nonmoving object weighing up to 1 pound per wizard level for 1 minute. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Creator's Will
powers.summary: Use minor creation, improving to major creation at 12th level, a number of times per day equal to half wizard level.

options.name: Enhancement School
options.benefit: Focus transmutation study on improving bodies and abilities. Retain transmutation specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Augment
powers.summary: Touch a creature to grant a temporary enhancement to one ability score or natural armor. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Perfection of Self
powers.summary: As a swift action, grant yourself a one-round enhancement bonus to one ability score equal to half wizard level, maximum +10, for wizard level uses per day.

options.name: Foresight School
options.benefit: Focus divination study on predicting immediate outcomes. Retain divination specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Prescience
powers.summary: Roll a d20 at the start of your turn and substitute that result for one required d20 roll before your next turn. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Foretell
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura that grants allies +2 luck bonuses or imposes -2 penalties on enemies for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Generation School
options.benefit: Focus evocation study on lingering effects and controlled blasts of air. Retain evocation specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Lingering Evocations
powers.summary: Evocation spells with non-instantaneous durations last additional rounds equal to half wizard level; at 20th level opposing dispel checks roll twice and take the worse result.

powers.name: Wind Servant
powers.summary: Hurl or catch unattended objects weighing up to 1 pound per wizard level within 30 feet. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

options.name: Life School
options.benefit: Focus necromancy study on transferring and restoring life energy. Retain necromancy specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Healing Grace
powers.summary: When casting a targeted, area, or attack spell, distribute healing equal to the spell level among affected creatures; this improves at 11th and 20th levels and harms undead instead.

powers.name: Share Essence
powers.summary: Take scaling nonlethal damage to grant a touched living creature the same amount of temporary hit points for 1 hour. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

options.name: Manipulator School
options.benefit: Focus enchantment study on charm and emotional influence. Retain enchantment specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Beguiling Touch
powers.summary: Charm a nonhostile living creature with no more Hit Dice than wizard level for half wizard level in rounds. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Shape Emotions
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura that protects allies from mind-affecting effects or penalizes enemies against them, for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Phantasm School
options.benefit: Focus illusion study on terrifying phantasms. Retain illusion specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Terror
powers.summary: A melee touch causes a creature with no more Hit Dice than wizard level to provoke an attack of opportunity. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Bedeviling Aura
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura that halves enemy speed, prevents their attacks of opportunity, and causes them to count as flanked, for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Scryer School
options.benefit: Focus divination study on remote observation. Retain divination specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Send Senses
powers.summary: Place a visible scrying sensor within medium range and see or hear through it for half wizard level in rounds. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

options.name: Shadow School
options.benefit: Focus illusion study on tangible darkness and travel through shadow. Retain illusion specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Binding Darkness
powers.summary: Entangle a foe within 30 feet with a ranged touch attack for scaling rounds. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Shadow Step
powers.summary: Travel through the Shadow Plane up to 30 feet per wizard level per day, in 5-foot increments, arriving slightly off target with 1 round of concealment.

options.name: Shapechange School
options.benefit: Focus transmutation study on battle-ready natural weapons. Retain transmutation specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Battleshaping
powers.summary: Grow a claw, bite, or gore attack for 1 round with a scaling enhancement bonus; grow two weapons at 11th level. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

options.name: Teleportation School
options.benefit: Focus conjuration study on short-range teleportation. Retain conjuration specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Shift
powers.summary: Teleport as a swift action to a visible space within 5 feet per two wizard levels without provoking. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

options.name: Undead School
options.benefit: Focus necromancy study on strengthening undead. Retain necromancy specialist slots and choose two opposition schools.

powers.name: Bolster
powers.summary: Touch an undead creature to grant scaling profane bonuses, temporary hit points, and turn resistance for half wizard level in rounds. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

options.name: Air School
options.benefit: Specialize in air, wind, lightning, and flight. Prepare one bonus spell from the Air elemental list at each available spell level and take Earth as the single opposition element.

powers.name: Air Supremacy
powers.summary: Gain a scaling Fly bonus and self-only feather fall at will, adding levitate at 5th level and fly at 10th; at 20th level treat Fly checks as natural 20s.

powers.name: Lightning Flash
powers.summary: Damage and dazzle creatures within 5 feet with electricity. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Cyclone
powers.summary: Create a defensive wind vortex that blocks ranged attacks and impedes creatures for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Earth School
options.benefit: Specialize in earth, stone, and acid. Prepare one bonus spell from the Earth elemental list at each available spell level and take Air as the single opposition element.

powers.name: Earth Supremacy
powers.summary: Gain scaling ground-based CMD defenses and +1 melee attack and damage while both combatants touch the ground; at 20th level cast through earth and stone when line of sight remains.

powers.name: Acid Cloud
powers.summary: Create a short-lived acid cloud that damages and sickens creatures. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Earth Glide
powers.summary: Move through natural earth, dirt, and stone for rounds per day equal to wizard level.

options.name: Fire School
options.benefit: Specialize in flame, heat, and purification. Prepare one bonus spell from the Fire elemental list at each available spell level and take Water as the single opposition element.

powers.name: Fire Supremacy
powers.summary: Gain fire resistance 5, increasing to 10 at 10th level and immunity at 20th, and draw nearby flame into a one-round retaliatory aura.

powers.name: Fire Jet
powers.summary: Project a 20-foot line of fire that can ignite targets. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Dancing Flame
powers.summary: Move nonmagical fire or reshape and reposition your fire spells. Uses per day equal half wizard level.

options.name: Water School
options.benefit: Specialize in water, cold, mist, and waves. Prepare one bonus spell from the Water elemental list at each available spell level and take Fire as the single opposition element.

powers.name: Water Supremacy
powers.summary: Gain a scaling Swim bonus and greatly extended breath holding, adding a swim speed at 10th level; at 20th level treat Swim checks as natural 20s.

powers.name: Cold Blast
powers.summary: Damage and stagger creatures within 5 feet with cold. Uses per day equal 3 + Intelligence modifier.

powers.name: Wave
powers.summary: Create a moving wave that knocks creatures prone, carries them, and extinguishes nonmagical fire for rounds per day equal half wizard level.
